This stunning **2023 Mercedes-Benz GLE 450 4MATIC** commands attention in sleek Obsidian Black Metallic, its bold AMG Line exterior delivering aggressive, sculpted styling with flared wheel arches, a powerful front apron, and a commanding presence that turns heads wherever it goes. Rolling on striking 20 AMG Twin 5-Spoke wheels, it exudes sporty sophistication enhanced by illuminated brushed aluminum running boards that light your path and add a touch of elegance with every entry.
Step inside to a luxurious sanctuary wrapped in rich Espresso Brown/Black MB-Tex upholstery, accented by natural grain Brown Walnut trim that brings warm, premium craftsmanship to every surface. The cabin envelops you in refined comfort, with heated front and rear seats inviting relaxation on any journey, while the heated multifunction steering wheel and 4-zone climate control ensure personalized bliss for all passengers. Premium interior lighting casts a captivating glow, highlighting the exquisite details and creating an ambiance of pure indulgence.
Technology takes center stage with the MBUX High-End Multimedia System featuring dual massive 12.3 displays that flow seamlessly across the dashboard, delivering intuitive navigation augmented by video for effortless guidance, live traffic updates, and smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Inductive wireless charging keeps devices powered, and the Burmester Surround Sound System immerses you in crystal-clear, concert-like audio that transforms every drive into an unforgettable experience.
Advanced driver assistance from the Driver Assistance Package elevates confidence with Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC, Active Steering Assist, Active Lane Change Assist, Traffic Sign Assist, and Active Stop-and-Go Assist, making highway cruising and stop-and-go traffic smoother and more secure. The Surround View Camera system provides a 360-degree perspective for precise maneuvering, while the panoramic sunroof floods the interior with natural light, expanding your sense of space and freedom.
This GLE 450 combines effortless power from its turbocharged inline-six engine with a 48-volt mild hybrid system for responsive performance and efficiency, paired with a smooth 9-speed transmission and confident 4MATIC all-wheel drive. Lowered suspension adds a sportier edge to the ride, and thoughtful touches like HANDS-FREE ACCESS, power liftgate, KEYLESS-GO, and Guard 360 security deliver convenience and peace of mind.
Ready to elevate every drive with unmatched luxury, cutting-edge innovation, and commanding style this GLE 450 is the ultimate expression of Mercedes-Benz excellence.

This impressive truck is more than just a workhorse - it's a statement of confidence and capability. With its striking Redline Edition features, including high-gloss Black accents, dark-bezel LED headlamps, and bold Red stripes, this Silverado commands attention wherever it goes.

- REDLINE EDITION
- Bed Protection Package
- Trailering Package
- Integrated Trailer Brake Controller
- 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 Engine with Dynamic Fuel Management
- 20 High Gloss Black Painted Aluminum Wheels with Red Stripes

Under the hood, the Silverado RST is powered by a potent 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 engine, delivering 355 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque. Paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4-wheel drive, this truck has the muscle to tackle any task with ease. Whether you're hauling heavy loads or towing your favorite toys, the Silverado RST is up for the challenge.

Beyond its impressive performance, this Silverado is packed with a wealth of convenient and advanced features. Experience the Unparalleled Power and Capability of the 2016 GMC Sierra 2500HD Denali

This remarkable 2016 GMC Sierra 2500HD Denali is a true workhorse, built to handle the toughest jobs with ease. Powered by the legendary Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine and paired with the reliable Allison 1000 6-Speed Automatic transmission, this truck delivers exceptional performance and capability. With its impressive 765 lb-ft of torque, the Sierra 2500HD Denali is ready to take on any challenge, whether it's hauling heavy loads or conquering off-road terrain.

- DURAMAX PLUS PACKAGE
- Sunroof, Power

- Suspension Package, Off-Road

- Trailering Wiring Provisions, for Trailering, Fifth Wheel and Gooseneck Trailer

The Sierra 2500HD Denali is more than just a powerful workhorse; it's a premium, feature-rich vehicle that offers unparalleled comfort and convenience. Indulge in the luxurious Bose 7-speaker sound system, dual-zone automatic climate control, and heated and ventilated front seats. Stay connected with the advanced IntelliLink infotainment system, complete with navigation, SiriusXM satellite radio, and wireless charging.

Safety is a top priority in the Sierra 2500HD Denali, with features like forward collision alert, lane departure warning, and ultrasonic front and rear park assist. The rear vision camera with dynamic guide lines and the Trailer Brake Controller provide added peace of mind when towing.

Elevate your driving experience with the distinctive style of the Sierra 2500HD Denali. Its bold, chrome-accented exterior and premium leather-appointed interior exude a sense of refined capability. The power-sliding rear window, 20-inch chrome wheels, and smoked amber roof marker lamps add a touch of sophistication to this impressive truck.

Whether you're tackling tough jobs or seeking a premium driving experience, the 2016 GMC Sierra 2500HD Denali is the perfect choice. Visit our showroom today to experience the unparalleled power, capability, and luxury of this exceptional vehicle.

AMAZING CONDITION 2003 Jeep Grand Cherokee Laredo 4x4 in incredible shape. You will not find a better example of a Grand Cherokee for sale.
SOUTHERN VEHICLE- this Jeep was located in Maryland and South Carolina from new until 2019.
Perfect CARFAX report with no accidents, no damage and no issues. Clean and clear title.
This is the WJ-body Grand Cherokee, the last of the Grand Cherokees to use the legendary AMC/Chrysler/Jeep 4.0L inline-6 which is renowned for its power output, reliability and ruggedness. These are highly overbuilt engines, and numerous articles describe this engine as one of the best off-road and 4x4 engines ever built. Many of these engines go 300,000 miles or more.
This Jeep has the following equipment and options: 4.0L 6-cylinder engine, 4x4 with low range, heated seats, A/C, power windows/locks, cruise control, ABS brakes, and trailer towing package.
There are also a number of modern convenience upgrades including touchscreen radio, Bluetooth for calls/audio, and backup camera.
This Jeep has a newly professionally-rebuilt/refreshed engine with new pistons, new connecting rods, new bearings, new lifters & pushrods and new cylinder head gasket. At the same time the Jeep received a new battery, new spark plugs and new ignition coil. This rebuild/refresh was due to a slightly noisy crankshaft bearing. All tolerances and specifications of the entire engine were checked and this engine is as good or better than new. It is outstandingly smooth, powerful and quiet.
This Jeep is in excellent mechanical condition. Everything on the Jeep is working exactly as it should. 100% dependable and reliable. Excellent engine, transmission, 4x4, brakes, suspension, steering and electronics. No leaks, no noises, no warning lights on and no check engine light on. This Grand Cherokee is a BEAST- it is ready to go anywhere you want, on or off road.
Extremely clean interior in beautiful shape. Excellent seats and upholstery, very clean trim and controls/buttons/switches. This interior is AMAZING for a 2003 vehicle. It has never been smoked in.
Excellent exterior with all-original paint in great shape. No dings or dents or issues. Good aluminum wheels with very good tires.
This Jeep has an incredible amount of life left in it, and it is an exceptional example.
Kept clean and detailed inside my heated garage in Willoughby, OH.
